admission_decision: none; this document is prospective accounting only

ledger_model.description: One hash-linked, contiguous, fsynced, nonrefundable global reservation ledger. Opening balance equals the inherited charged units. Ordinal 0 is the single inherited full-gate-pair reserve. Each later row reserves one command's complete mixed-unit accounting before execution; no retry identity and no refund path exist; every post-reservation failure or unknown outcome retains its charge.
ledger_model.command_accounting_rule: Each scientific command's accounting is a typed nonnegative mixed-unit map of 2..8 keys that must include planning_fixture_calls=4096 and at least one positive non-fixture unit; the reservation equals the sum of all values.
ledger_model.grand_total_rule: grand_total = inherited_charged_units + full_gate_pair_units_once + sum(all command reservations); admission requires grand_total <= cumulative_ceiling with every audit, control and repeat charge already listed.
ledger_model.repeat_rule: A repeat row binds an earlier non-repeat command and duplicates its full accounting; at least two repeats are required by the controller obligation.
ledger_model.retry_zero_rule: No retry identity exists: retries budgeted = 0, refund = 0. Any re-execution is a new full-charge command reservation (a repeat), never a credit.

per_command_always.note: Applies to every scientific command including controls and repeats; counted once per command.

control_suite_components.baseline_charges: Exactly one positive baseline invocation per layer per suite: outer-binding 1, inventory-auditor 40512, retained-auditor 192+35*n; baselines are inside the (1 + mutations) factors.

retry_zero_charge.rule: Every post-reservation failure or unknown outcome is retained nonrefundably; re-execution only via a new full-charge repeat reservation.

current_ceiling_refusal.basis: The smallest quoted complete control suite (single 4-history all-available invocation, 296979 units) already exceeds the 76582-unit margin remaining after the shared-inventory two-sweep plan (4923418). The inventory-auditor control component alone (283584 + 4096 fixture = 287680) exceeds 76582 even if every retained control were unavailable. The self-contained two-sweep variant totals 5012634 and exceeds the ceiling by 12634 before any control or repeat. Under the current ceiling no complete plan exists.
current_ceiling_refusal.prerequisite: Even a ceiling-fit plan would still require the missing clean candidate, source closure, phase manifests, two fresh Sol xhigh reviews, an admitted injector path for the refusing controls __main__, and would remain partial validation while the 87-command inherited gates stay Windows-bound.

minimum_ceiling_if_all_components_global.assumption: One shared audited inventory, two 16x24 sweeps, one complete control suite over one 4-history all-available shard, every local label charged additively into the global ledger, two repeats of the cheapest command (retained-auditor, 5128 each).
minimum_ceiling_if_all_components_global.note: 5,220,397 is the sourced refusal-bound figure; any larger control shard or wider control coverage only raises the minimum.

proposed_dynamic_ceiling.coverage_choice: Option E: the validation contract requires each of the two complete successor gates to add every new checker, controls and retained audits, so inventory controls are reserved per gate and outer/retained controls per produced shard across both sweeps.
reserve_rules: The 435126-unit reserve is explicit unused headroom, not allocated to any command.
Any draw against the reserve requires a prospective budget revision before the affected reservation; the ledger itself stays nonrefundable.

Reserve absorbs: escalation of the two mandatory repeats up to one inventory-control command (287680) plus shard-level repeats, or up to 13 additional retained-auditor repeats (5128 each), or up to 4 additional per-shard control commands (32995 each) plus one retained-auditor repeat.

Reserve does NOT absorb: a third complete gate or sweep, two additional inventory-control commands (575360), or per-shard controls on any third sweep; those require a new prospective revision and a higher ceiling.

If a future admitted controller mapping lawfully proves control inventory calls identical to already-reserved producer/audit units (the currently unadmitted non-additive claim), the ceiling must be revised downward, never silently undercharged.
proposed_dynamic_ceiling.dynamic_ceiling_semantics: This is a prospective proposed revision value only. It does not change the live 5000000 ceiling; under the current ceiling the plan remains REFUSED.

unresolved_accounting: Whether any non-additive ledger mapping may lawfully collapse control inventory-auditor invocations (283584/suite) into already-reserved producer/audit units; the packet marks this mapping unadmitted, so this plan reserves them additively.
Whether outer-binding is required per produced shard (32x) or once per campaign; conservative proposal uses per-shard.
Whether inventory controls are required once per campaign or once per gate; conservative proposal uses per-gate (2x).
Which commands the two mandatory repeats target; minimum assumes the cheapest repeatable command (retained-auditor, 5128).
Whether retained controls must cover all 32 produced shards or a subset; conservative proposal covers all produced shards.
Actual per-shard available_retained count (0..27) is unknown until real artifacts exist; conservative proposal reserves all 27 available.

Whether unavailable-reachable-witness is campaign-fatal is undefined in the supplied sources; pass criteria for incomplete suites remain an open required check.
Actual detection power of controls against real inventory_audit.py/boundary_audit.py artifacts is unknown without execution.
